adjudication.depicted_input: Pathology image thumbnail, the VQA question/options, and a full candidate model answer that can serve as the proposed solution for the self-verifier.
adjudication.rationale: The current full-width top strip is too shallow and overweights comparative output snippets across unrelated models. A tighter upper-left crop from the same figure is defensible because it visibly contains three actual verifier inputs from the paper’s example workflow: the pathology image, the question text, and one complete proposed answer. That satisfies the image, question, and proposed-solution routes. The verifier prompt text itself is not visibly shown, so the prompt route is not supported by this crop.
